_meta.name: OFFICE iQ — Quiz DUMMY TEMPLATE (rules-only, no real content)
_meta.purpose: Upload via the admin Catalog screen's Content step 'Upload Quiz JSON' button (POST /api/admin/catalog/:id/content/quiz, ADR 0027) to add/replace the daily-quiz pool on an EXISTING catalog entry that already has tickets uploaded — or pick this file separately as the 'Quiz file (.json, optional)' in the same 'Add workspace' modal as company-tickets-template.json to include it in a brand-new entry (POST /api/admin/catalog/import, ADR 0009; the two files are merged client-side, no need to combine them yourself). This `_meta` block is ignored on import.
howToUse: 1. Replace the sample entries with real ones — at most 200, each MUST have exactly 4 `options` and a `correctIndex` in 0..3.
2. Delete this `_meta` block (optional — it's stripped automatically) and upload.

hardLimits.quizQuestions: 1 to 200 items (the button requires at least one)

notes: This upload PATCHES the current active content pack in place — tickets and DSA problems are left exactly as they were, no new pack version is created.

The catalog entry must already have tickets uploaded (via the Tickets button or 'Add workspace') before a quiz can be uploaded — otherwise the request fails with a 422 telling you to upload tickets first.
`correctIndex` and `.explanation` are stored server-side and never sent to candidates before they submit — write real answers, they are not shown early.
Malformed questions are silently dropped (not fatal) rather than failing the whole upload — a partly-bad quiz file still gets you the valid questions.
Only 2 samples are shown to keep this template short — copy an object to add more, up to the 200 hard limit.

quizQuestions.question: <MCQ question text, max 500 chars>
quizQuestions.explanation: <why the correct option is right, shown to candidates only after they submit>
